limitations: Local TLS issuer only; public DNS, ACME issuance and a merchant host remain deployment checks.
PHPMailer identifies extensionless private temporary attachments as application/octet-stream; the .pdf display filename and complete decoded PDF bytes are verified separately.
No production email provider, managed hosting, paid entitlements or merchant data used.
The renderer remains one process with in-memory capacity limits; this is not metered SaaS or a high-availability claim.

visualReview.result: Inspected final rendered PDF pages: headings, item data and totals are visible without overlap or clipping in these fixtures.

limitations: Evaluation prerelease; no paid checkout, automatic updater or marketplace approval.
Synthetic data only. WordPress email hooks and MIME are exercised with captured outbound mail and an HTTPS test filter using actual Fullbleed PDF bytes; no production delivery claim.
The public sample store demonstrates the free editor and browser downloads. Pro automation is not enabled there.
The 32-item summary retains content across four pages but places the closing section on its own final page; this is not a perfect-pagination claim for arbitrary templates.
Safari, merchant-specific templates, additional language coverage, live paid lifecycle and continuous production operation remain open.
Historical Shopify hosted/installed-store and privacy drills are not reclassified as this release evidence.
